# Carcavelos Daily Brief – June 30

**Clean NW swell in the 1.8–1.9m range all day—summer consistency at its best.**

**Morning (sunrise 03:20):** Best window is 07:00–11:00 when winds drop to 10–12 km/h from the north. Waves holding steady around 1.85m with long-period swell (7.85s). Water temp 19–24°C, so boardies are fine. This is your cleaner, less crowded slot before the day heats up.

**Progression:** Swell gradually eases through lunch and afternoon as winds veer NNW and increase to 15–19 km/h by 18:00. Wave shape stays reasonable until mid-afternoon, then chops pick up.

**Afternoon (post-12:00):** Rideable but messier. Swell drops to 1.3–1.5m by late session. Better for learners or a cruisey lap than serious waves.

**Tips:** Grab a shortboard or funboard this morning while conditions are clean. Avoid the heat of 14:00–17:00 anyway. Crowd factor should be moderate—most locals will chase this early window too.
